1.consolidated_definition: Muerto viviente controlado por un hechicero; por extensión, persona carente de fuerzas y voluntad. Anglicismo crudo, usual. La última semana cuando la pasamos en España, era... pero caminando como si fuéramos zombies, porque era el cansancio…
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Controlled undead person manipulated by a sorcerer; by extension, a person lacking in strength and willpower. 

Anglicism, commonly used. 

During the last week when we were in Spain, it was... but walking as if we were zombies, because of fatigue…
